title: Repair backup containment, complete manifests and atomic restore
detail: restore.rs validates lexical paths but follows pre-existing parent/leaf symlinks, may write outside target, truncates valid destination before checksum and deletes it on failure. It returns success when manifest-listed members are absent and ignores expected sizes/duplicate manifests/members. Retention must prove backup ownership instead of deleting arbitrary .gz files. Add real filesystem tests for malicious links, missing/duplicate entries, corruption rollback, existing target preservation, source/output boundaries and retention ownership. DB metadata alone is not a DB backup; no encryption/selective restore/Restic claims without implementation.
